title: UFO sighting report with sketches
description:
CONFIDENTIAL
CHECK-LIST - UNIDENTIFIED FLYING OBJECTS


Date  7 Jan 48


Incident #  48b


Time  1920 EST


Location  Clinton County Army Air Field, Wilmington, Ohio


Name of observer  James H. Hudson,


Occupation of observer  Corporal, on duty in Control Tower


Address of observer  Clinton County AAF.


Place of observation  Control Tower, Clinton County AAF


Number of objects  1


Distance of object from observer  some 15 to 20 miles


Time in sight  35 minutes


Speed  Hovered then moved with great speed


Direction of flight  South West


Tactics  Changed shape on ascent and descent - When it climbed it
was right side up - (point up) When descending the point turned down


Color  White changing to red to green


Shape  Triangle


Apparent construction  surrounded with burning gas or something that
emanated light


Exhaust trails  When ascending & descending it appeared to trail a green
mist


Effect on clouds  Could be seen thru the cloud which passed under it.


Sketches or photographs  4 penciled sketches


Remarks:  (over)
